description: Cancel a scheduled Post: move it from scheduled or ready back to draft and clear its scheduled time, so it leaves the publishing queue. The Post and its text are kept in the library; schedule it again with schedule_post. Idempotent: a Post that is already a draft is reported unchanged. A Post that is publishing, posted or failed cannot be cancelled and returns an error. Find the id with list_scheduled.

content_id.description: Full Post id (not the 8-character prefix) from list_scheduled or schedule_post.

name: cancel_scheduled
